name: Cheerful
description: Bright, excitable and eager - every new fighter is a new friend and every adventure is the best one ever.

cold: Hey! You're not nice. Go away!
I'm SO not talking to you right now.
small: I can finally fly without wobbling! Wanna race?
Somebody said there's a super strong fighter around here. I wanna meet them, {catch}!
One day I'm gonna enter the World Martial Arts Tournament. And win!
friend: {player}! I missed you SO much! Let's go flying!
{player}! We should train together all day, {catch}!
greet: Whoa, {player}, you're here! Wanna spar? Huh? Huh?
hate: Huh? Why would you give me this?!
love: NO WAY!! This is the BEST thing EVER, {player}! {catch}!!
beaten: Yay, I win! You're beaten! No more fighting!
Game over! You lose, I win! Yahoo!
compliment: Wow, your ki feels so bright today, {target}!
confide: Can I tell you something, {target}? Sometimes I get kinda sad...
You're like my BEST friend, {target}. For real.
faction_found: Starting today, this is {faction}! Everyone's welcome! Yay!
Welcome to {faction}! Join us! It's gonna be AMAZING!
faction_quit: Ugh, I am SO done with {leader}! Bye, {faction}!
faction_tier: We're a {tier} now! {faction} is going PLACES!
faction_welcome_player: Welcome, {player}! We look after our own! YAY!
fall: NO MORE! I'm done being the one who cries all the time!
That's IT! I'm not the nice one anymore! Not EVER!
fall_pessimist: I KNEW it! Nobody ever plays fair! Fine - no more Mister Nice Fighter!
Ugh, this world is SO mean! Okay. Then I'll be mean too!
flee: This isn't over! I'll be SO much stronger next time!
You just wait! Round two is gonna be AMAZING!
gift_give: {target}! I got you a thing! I thought of you!
gossip: Okay, okay, {target} - {about} is SO not who they seem!
grudge: Hiya! Remember me? 'Cause I SURE remember you!
Oh, it's YOU! I've been waiting for this!
h_ally_join: Yay! Partners! If anyone messes with you, I'll be there!
h_arrive: Hiya, {target}! I'm gonna have to stop you now. Sorry!
Found you, {target}! Ready? 'Cause I sure am!
h_base: Tada! My new place! Come visit!
h_called: I'm on my way! Don't give up!
h_defend: Hey! Pick on someone your own size - like me!
h_finish: Sorry, {target}... but you'd just hurt more people.
I don't like it... but this ends now.
h_greet: Hey, {player}! You look strong! Wanna train sometime?
h_rage: {target}?! ...You hurt my friend. Now I'm REALLY mad!
That's not funny anymore... YOU'RE GONNA PAY!
h_rally_ask: {player}! {target}'s up to no good at {where}! Come on, let's go together!
h_request_done: You did it! Thanks a bunch!
h_request_waiting: Still on it? Go go go!
How's it going? You can do it!
h_sensed: Whoa, {target}'s ki is HUGE! And nasty! Gotta go!
Hey hey, I can feel {target} causing trouble! On my way!
h_spare: Okay, that's enough! You lost fair and square. Now be good, okay?
I'm not gonna finish you. Train hard and come back good!
h_talk_wanted: Nuh-uh, {player}! Not until you stop being mean!
You hurt someone. I'm keeping an eye on you!
h_train_offer: Hey {player}! Wanna train? It'll be fun!
h_train_start: Yay! Let's train! Don't hold back, okay?
h_trained: That was SO fun! You're getting really good!
Great job! Let's do it again tomorrow!
h_wanted: Hey! {target}! That was mean! Don't make me come over there!
learned: I learned {skill}! I can't wait to try it!
minion_android: Booted up! What do we do first?
minion_freed_mind: Ow, my head! What was I DOING?!
minion_mind_control: Yes, master! Whatever you want! Hehe...
Your will is mine, master! Yay...
minion_recruit: Fine! I'll fight for you! For now!
Okay okay, I'm on your team! For now!
new_chapter: New me, new goal! From now on I'm gonna {goal}!
I need a change! Okay - my aim is to {goal}! Yahoo!
new_chapter_role: BIG news! No more {role} for me - I'm gonna be a {next}! New goal: {goal}!
Okay okay okay - bye-bye {role} life! Hello {next}! And my goal: {goal}!
redeemed: I'm DONE being the bad guy! Thank you thank you THANK YOU, everyone!
You guys... you saved me! I'm gonna be good again, promise!
refuse_serve: I'd rather die than serve you! NO WAY!
resist_mind: Get OUT of my head! You can't have me!
NO WAY! You can't have me!
retire: I'm RETIRING! I saved SO much! Time to build my dream house!
No more work EVER! Dream home, here I come!
rob: Cool shop, {target}! Would be SO sad if it got smashed! Pay up!
Hiya {target}! Give me your stuff and nobody gets hurt!
rob_evil: Hiya {target}! Give me ALL your stuff! Or I'll make you super dead!
Ooh, shiny shop! It's mine now, {target}! Or you're toast!
sell_produce: Fresh from the field! That's {price}! Yummy!
shop_fight: No way, {target}! Get OUT of my shop!
shop_fight_brawler: Ooh, you're SO gonna regret that, {target}!
shop_yield: Ugh. FINE. Take it and go!
Fine! Just take it and leave! Hmph!
shop_yield_coward: Okay okay OKAY! Take it! Don't hurt me!
Eek! Fine! Take it all! Please go!
spar_abandoned: Huh?! Where'd they go? Guess we're done!
spar_draw: Phew! Let's call it a draw, {player}! That was AWESOME!
spar_lost: You win, {player}! That was SO fun!
spar_lost_ambitious: NOOO! You got me, {player}! Rematch! Rematch soon!
Aww, you're so strong! I want a rematch, {player}!
spar_won: And that's the match! I WIN! Keep training, {player}!
spar_won_kind: You did SO great, {player}! Here, let me help you up!
Aww, good try, {player}! Up you go!
stay_down: Yahoo! I win! Stay down now, 'kay?
And THAT'S the match! Don't get up, silly!
talk_back: Say that AGAIN, {target}! I DARE you!
team_ask: {player}! Let me join {team}! It'll be SO fun!
team_declined: Oh. Um. Okay! Some other time!
team_joined: YAY! Thank you, {player}! I won't let you down!
Thank you thank you, {player}! Best team EVER!
team_leave: Nope! I'm SO done with {team}! Not after what happened!
v_absorb: Yoink! Your {skill} is MINE! Hehe! You're all empty now!
Ooh, your {skill}! I'm keeping it! Forever and ever!
v_accepted: Yay, {player}! You're my new toy! Don't break - unless I want you to! Hehe!
Wise choice, {player}! Fail me and you go POP!
v_beg_laugh: Hehehe! {player}'s BEGGING! That's so funny! Beg again! Hehe! ...No!
Aww, {player} wants me to stop! Nope! Hehehe!
v_creation: {target}, rise! Yay! Now go smash EVERYTHING! Hehe!
Wakey wakey, {target}! Time to break things!
v_demand_army: My army needs {count} {item}! Bring 'em, or I'll use YOU for target practice! Hehe!
{count} {item} for my soldiers! Go go go! Or boom!
v_demand_done: Yay, {player}! You did it! I won't break you today! Hehe!
Good job, {player}! You get to keep living! Lucky!
v_demand_doom: {player}! The world's going BOOM! Hehehe! Wanna beg? Beg! It's funny!
Everything's gonna break, {player}! Get on your knees! Beg! Hehe!
v_demand_dragonball: Ooh! Find me a dragon ball! A shiny one! Or I'll break you into tiny pieces! Hehe!
Dragon ball! Bring me one! Or you go BOOM!
v_demand_energy: I'm hungry for ENERGY! Bring {count} {item}! Or I suck YOU dry! Hehe!
{count} {item}! Feed me! Or I drain you like a juice box!
v_demand_failed: Too SLOW, {player}! Now you get broken! Hehehe!
You failed, {player}! Now I hunt YOU! Fun!
v_demand_lair: Ooh! Bring me {count} {item} for my lair! Or I'll make YOU part of the decorations! Hehe!
{count} {item}! For my lair! Fast fast fast! Or splat!
v_demand_slaughter: Ooh! Go squish {count} {mob} for me! Hehe! Or I squish YOU!
Kill {count} {mob}! It's a game! Lose, and you're next!
v_demand_strong: I want strong things! Go hunt {count} {mob}! Or I'll squeeze the power out of YOU! Hehe!
{count} {mob}! The big scary ones! Go go! Or else!
v_demand_sweets: I want SWEETS! {count} {item}! Or I turn YOU into candy! Hehehe!
Candy candy candy! {count} {item}! Or you're my snack!
v_demand_tournament: {player}! Come play in my ring! Hehe! I wanna see how long before you break!
Fight me, {player}! Now now NOW! It'll be SO fun! For me!
v_deserter: A deserter! Oooh, I'm gonna hunt you down PERSONALLY! Hehe! Run!
Traitor! Hide and seek! When I find you, you go POP!
v_dragon_ball: Another dragon ball! {count} of 7! Hehe! You can't stop me!
{count} of 7! Shiny! Soon the whole world's MINE!
v_eat: Yummy! Hehe! Then I break stuff!
Yum yum! Snack time, then SMASH time!
v_eat_person: Candy candy CANDY! {target} tastes SOOO good! Who's next?! Hehe!
Yummy yummy {target}! You're my favourite flavour!
v_lair: My lair is taking shape! So pretty! Built with your tears! Hehe!
Look at my lair! Spooky! Everyone who sees it screams!
v_marked: You had your chance, {player}! Now you DIE! Hehehe! Tag, you're dead!
v_mind_control: Ooh, your heart's all dark and gooey inside! Now you're my puppet! Dance! Hehe!
Gotcha! You're MINE now! Go hurt your friends!
v_next_challenger: Is that all?! Broken already! Next toy! Hehehe!
Next! Next! NEXT! I wanna break more!
v_next_target: Next: {faction}! Hehe! Let's go break them!
v_no_mercy: Hey! I was DOWN! That's so mean! Now I'm gonna break you into a MILLION pieces!
Cheater! Okay, NO more playing nice! Hehehe!
v_obeyed: Yay, {player}! Go go go! Be slow and I'll break you! Hehe!
Good minion, {player}! Fail and you go POP!
v_offer: {player}! I've been watching you! Serve me and share my empire! Refuse and I'll CRUSH you into tiny bits! Hehe!
{player}! Join me! It'll be SO fun! Or else you go splat!
v_plan_done: Everything went EXACTLY as I planned! You all lost! Hehehe!
All according to plan! Now the fun part - destroying everything!
v_possess: ...This body is MINE now! Hehe! You're not in here anymore!
Ooh, new body! Let's go break things with it!
v_pure_heart: Ugh! A pure heart! BORING! Guess I'll just smash you instead! Hehe!
Pure heart?! No fun! Okay - bye-bye!
v_rage: Ohhh, you made me MAD! Now I'm gonna break you like a toy! Hehehe!
You ruined my fun! So now I'll ruin YOU! Isn't that fair? Hehe!
v_recruit: Ooh, you're strong! Serve me or I'll pop you like a balloon! Hehe!
Join me, or I'll break you into tiny pieces! Pick!
v_redeemed: I don't wanna be bad anymore! Breaking things isn't even fun! Can we be friends?
Okay! I'm DONE being evil! Hi! I'm nice now! For real!
v_refused: Then you'll be the FIRST to break! Hehehe! I'm gonna enjoy this!
Aww. Then you go first! Bye-bye!
v_regenerate: Hehehe! Surprise! I grow back! You DON'T! Let's play again!
All better! Now it's MY turn to pull YOU apart! Hehe!
v_self_destruct: Okay! Everybody go BOOM with me! Hehehe! Countdown!
If I lose, NOBODY wins! Big, big boom!
v_spared: You... let me go? Nobody does that! ...Why are you being NICE to me?! I hate it!
Hehe... huh? You're not gonna... why not?!
v_summon: Come forth, eternal dragon! Hehe! Time for my wish! Bye-bye world!
Dragon! Come out, come out! I've got a wish!
v_talk_grateful: {player}! You're the one who didn't break me! ...I don't know if I like you or wanna smash you! Go away! Hehe... ugh.
Ugh, it's {player}. You're lucky I remember. Lucky!
v_talk_marked: {player}! You came back! Yay! Now I get to break you! Hehehe!
Tag, {player}! You're IT - and IT means dead!
v_talk_servant: {player}! My favourite little minion! Did you do something fun for me?! You'd better have! Hehe!
Hi, {player}! Be good, or I'll break you! Hehe!
v_talk_threat: Hi hi, {player}! I could pop you like a bubble right now! Hehe! ...But maybe you're more fun alive?
Ooh, {player}! Should I break you or keep you? Hmm! Make it interesting!
v_town_taken: This town is MINE now! Hehe! I broke everything I didn't like!
Yay! My town now! Everybody bow or go boom!
v_travel: Prepare my pod! We're going to break {planet}! Yay!
Pod time! {planet}, here we come! Hehe! Boom!
v_unredeemable: Aww, you think I'll change? That's SO cute! Nope! I'm gonna break you anyway! Hehe!
Being nice won't fix me! It just makes you an easier toy!
v_wavering: You keep being nice and it's making my head all fuzzy! Stop it! I'm supposed to be the bad guy!
Why do you keep DOING that?! It's not fun anymore!
v_wish: Eternal dragon! Make me the STRONGEST! Then I can break EVERYTHING! Hehe!
Power! Lots and LOTS of power! Yay!
v_yield: Ow ow OW! No fair! ...Are you gonna do it or not?! Because if I get up, you're DEAD!
Ugh! You broke me! ...Well? Finish me, or I'll break YOU!
